notes: New Dispatch (8 Oct 2026): CP30 New Dispatch 2030 has 2,090 MW of transmission biomass and 900 MW of CCS biomass (two converted Drax units, against one in Further Flex). Not re-priced under public ownership: legacy plant on a bridging contract, so DRAX_BRIDGE is deliberately absent from cfd_round_award_years.csv.
